description: Polyphonic state-variable filter with resonance, wet-dry mix and output gain, offering lowpass, bandpass, highpass and notch outputs at the same time

params.text: Sets the corner frequency, spanning 5 octaves either side of C5 at 523.251Hz, with each unit on the dial an octave
Attenuates and inverts the frequency CV; fully clockwise the CV input tracks a volt per octave
Sets the resonance from 0 to 1; higher values concentrate the passband around the corner frequency, and near the top the filter rings on its own
Attenuates and inverts the resonance CV
Balances filtered against unfiltered audio: at 1 the output is entirely filtered, at 0 it matches the input
Attenuates and inverts the mix CV
Makes the output louder or quieter, a built-in VCA on the way out; it glows red while the output limiter is reducing gain
Attenuates and inverts the gain CV
Repeats the filter 1 to 3 times in series, steepening the slope; whole numbers give that many stages and values between blend two neighbouring counts. Monophonic and manual only

inputs.text: Audio to be filtered, 1 to 16 channels, each filtered on its own
Moves the corner frequency; with its attenuverter fully clockwise it tracks a volt per octave, and a cable with fewer channels than the audio repeats its last channel across the rest
Varies the balance between filtered and unfiltered audio

outputs.text: The lowpass output, with the same number of channels as the audio input
The bandpass output, with the same number of channels as the audio input
The highpass output, with the same number of channels as the audio input
The notch output, with the same number of channels as the audio input

notes: a higher cascade setting costs more CPU time
a high cascade setting together with a high resonance setting can overload the filter, which flashes a bright colour and resets itself when the output passes 100V either way
menu: Output limiter — sets a threshold from 5V to 50V, or turns off at the far right; the GAIN knob glows red while it is reducing the output
Limiter warning light — turns off the red glow on the GAIN knob without turning the limiter off
Toggle sensitivity on all attenuverters — divides the effect of every attenuverter on the panel by 10, or restores them all
Configure for V/OCT — on the FREQ attenuverter's own menu, not the panel menu: sets that attenuverter so the frequency CV tracks a volt per octave
Low sensitivity — on an attenuverter knob's own menu, not the panel menu: divides that knob's effect by 10 and marks the knob with an orange dot
Unipolar mode — on an attenuverter knob's own menu, not the panel menu: adds 5V to the CV on that control and clamps the result at zero
